description: Results of the study "Coordinated planning of European charging infrastructure and energy system for optimal V1G and V2G deployment is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Francesco Davide Sanvito (TU Delft). This repository contains the results of optimising the models available on Zenodo using the energy system optimisation framework Calliope. The utilised models are derived from Sector-coupled Euro-Calliope and Euro-Calliope. The model evaluates the impacts of different charging strategies for passenger electric vehicles (EVs) on the European energy system. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
